unit.why: After a short non-narrative note on the Seer of Lublin always defending Korah, the division holds one narrative: R. Leibush of Tarnogrod, a skeptic, meets the Seer during his visit and gets commercial advice.
unit.boundary_note: Opens with a brief saying/habit note (Seer defends Korah); story continues into next division

stories.start_quote: סיפר הרה״ג ר׳ ליבוש מטארנינדאר אבי
stories.end_quote: ויאמר הה״ק להרב ר״ל הלא זה
stories.summary_en: R. Leibush of Tarnogrod, a wealthy scholar who privately mocked the Seer of Lublin on his visit to town, is told by the Seer to sell his honey and hoard wax against coming price changes; meanwhile R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov knocks at the door.

tags.why: A non-Hasidic scholar who scorns tzaddikim interacts with the Seer
